_doc: rva (ELF vaddr, Ghidra address minus 0x10000) -> name. Game/build specific. Each name was derived from the decompiled body or call sites, not from a symbol; basis in _basis.<rva>. Names are behavior names, not the original C++ names unless stated.

_basis.1a2ef20: Call sites test (klass+0xbd)&1==0 then klass=f(klass) (IL2CPP_RUNTIME_CLASS_INIT). Body: Class::Init(klass) then raises when klass+0x6c != 0. Returns klass.
_basis.1a549ac: il2cpp_init_metadata (0x19f54c8) is only this call plus a memory barrier. Body switches on token>>29 (type info / type / method / field / string literal) and caches the result in the usage cell.
_basis.1a4fa7c: Body: if (!(klass->flags@0xbd & 2)) { lock; InitLocked(klass); unlock }, i.e. Class::Init. Exported il2cpp_array_new*, il2cpp_array_class_get, il2cpp_shutdown call it first (api_calls.json).
_basis.1a31db4: (obj, klass) -> obj when assignable (including interface/COM path), else NULL; null in -> null out. Callers throw InvalidCast on NULL for castclass.
_basis.19f5470: Same card-marking store as helper il2cpp_wbarrier (0x19f546c): if (gc flag) table[idx>>17] |= 1 << ((idx&0x1ffff)>>12). Reached through a different entry address, treated as the same barrier.
_basis.19f5624: (ex, method): zeroes ex+0x1c and ex+0x20 (trace fields) and raises; callers pass a freshly built exception, i.e. the compiled form of C# `throw`. Rest of the body is garbage to the decompiler (unwind code).
_basis.143b1c8: (array, index, value): index >= array+0xc (length) -> il2cpp_throw_index; stores at array+0x10+index*4; then the GC card-marking write barrier.
_basis.143b18c: (array, value): value==NULL returns; isinst(value, array element class) non-NULL returns; else builds an exception and raises (ArrayTypeMismatch) - the check done before storing into a reference array.
_basis.19f5b2c: (obj, klass): builds "Unable to cast object of type '<obj class name>' to type '<klass name>'." (C strings read at 0x1a3a7fc/0x1a3a818/0x1a3a834 in callee 0x1a2a7c4), creates System.InvalidCastException ("System"/"InvalidCastException" in callee 0x1a3960c) and raises.
_basis.1a2ef7c: Call sites: m = <Method$...>; if (m+0x1c == 0) f(m). Callee 0x1a13708 fills m+0x1c lazily under a lock from the generic data at m+0x20 (MethodInfo rgctx/generic data). Returns m. Behaviour name, not the C++ name.
_basis.19f54e8: (obj, field) -> obj + *(field+0xc) (field offset), minus 8 when the parent class (field+8) is a value type (class+0x14 < 0): address of an instance field. Ghidra shows it as a thunk of 0x1a4c034.
_basis.19f5484: Its only argument is a C string with an internal-call signature, e.g. "UnityEngine.Rigidbody::AddForceAtPosition_Injected(System.IntPtr,UnityEngine.Vector3&,UnityEngine.Vector3&,UnityEngine.ForceMode)" (read with ReadCStrings.java); the result is cast to a function pointer, cached in a static and called. That is il2cpp_codegen_resolve_icall.
